fabric.widthControl: minimality — this environment declares no parent-range/IPAM allocation convention for the exporter pool, so the minimal aligned cover is the sole control on range width
fabric.cidrDerivationRule: smallest CIDR block, aligned to a valid prefix boundary, containing every selected interface's IPv4 address (Design decision: CIDR representation)
fabric.exporterSelectionRule: IPv4 address of every fabric interface whose description marks it as a telemetry exporter (Design decision: Exporter population)

crossingValue.name: fabricExporterCidr
crossingValue.delivery: DAG edge (chained §6 context) from the fabric leg — NOT a static value in this contract. Each consuming leg must treat it as chained input; if §6 does not carry it, escalate — never guess, substitute, or recompute.
crossingValue.consumptionRule: consumed verbatim by every consumer — never recomputed, never widened, never guessed

platformDialect.appliesTo: observability leg only — insert into each of the two OTLP-facing server blocks (4317 and 4318), above any existing catch-all allow, terminated by the deny-all; no deny directive may reference a scope narrower or wider than <FABRIC_CIDR>
platformDialect.placeholder: <FABRIC_CIDR> resolves at runtime to crossingValue.fabricExporterCidr — never a value fixed in this contract

readOnlyServiceLifecycle: Each leg self-provisions its own read-only MCP registration from its own descriptor URL, harvests read-only, then tears the registration down — on approval AND on escalation alike.
